name: Build a Realtime API and Pinecone Knowledge Base
description_md:
What You'll Get:

- 
Replit Code for Realtime API Integration:
- Step-by-step code to set up the OpenAI Realtime API in your projects.

- Easy-to-follow instructions suitable for both beginners and experienced developers.

- 
Replit Code for Pinecone Assistant and Knowledge Base:
- Code to build and integrate the Pinecone assistant, creating a "brain" for your AI phone agent.

- Guidance on ingesting documents so your AI can answer with surgical precision.

- 
Comprehensive Slide Deck Presentation:
- A detailed breakdown of how the entire system works.

- Visual explanations to help you understand each component and how they interact.

- 
Resource Links to Essential Tools:
- Direct links to tools like Twilio and Pinecone.

- Tips on setting up and configuring these tools for your AI assistant.
